newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent bullish, gas oil fills gap, heads higher.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent bullish, gas oil fills gap, heads higher.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures held their bullish tone over the morning with gas oil ramping higher after filling a chart gap and Brent testing resistance, traders said.
By 1200 GMT September Brent stood 18 cents a barrel firmer at $19.17, moving above $19.15 where Wednesday's rally failed and just below technical resistance at $19.20.
Traders said they expected to see a stronger NYMEX this afternoon with NYMEX crude already testing Wednesday's high in ACCESS trade backed up by stronger products.
Gas oil was up $3.75 at $173.75 a tonne.
Traders said they expected NYMEX heating oil to provide followthrough support for gas oil with stronger U.S. markets expected to draw arbitrage product from Europe.
September gas oil quickly filled the $171-$172 gap left on last Thursday and Friday and tested $174 on Thursday.
Brokers said Brent was technically strong but could also be drawing some support from tighter North Sea loadings next month.
The September Brent programme scheduled the equivalent of three fewer standard 500,000-barrel cargoes than in August. Forties loadings are also expected to fall.
